description: Source code for the Snake game implementation in Android, defining the SnakeView class which manages game state, rendering, and user interactions.

classes.name: SnakeView
classes.description: Custom View class implementing the Snake game logic, rendering, and user interaction handling.

classes.name: Coordinate
classes.description: Helper class representing x,y coordinates on the game grid.

methods.name: initSnakeView
methods.description: Initializes the game tiles and loads drawable resources.

methods.name: initNewGame
methods.description: Sets up a new game with initial snake position and apples.

methods.name: coordArrayListToArray
methods.description: Converts a list of Coordinates to a flattened int array.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Serializes current game state into a Bundle.

methods.name: coordArrayToArrayList
methods.description: Reconstructs a list of Coordinates from a flattened int array.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores game state from a Bundle.

methods.name: moveSnake
methods.description: Handles user input to change snake direction and start new game.

methods.name: setDependentViews
methods.description: Assigns UI components for game status and controls.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Changes game mode and updates UI visibility accordingly.

methods.name: addRandomApple
methods.description: Places a new apple at a random location not occupied by the snake.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Main game loop update, moves snake and updates display if game is running.

methods.name: updateSnake
methods.description: Moves the snake, checks collisions, and updates the display.
